create_DeepRcfrModel: create a deep feedforward RCFR model with configurable hidden layers, skip connections, and activation functions for a given OpenSpiel game
build_RcfrSolver: build an RCFR solver with infinite regret data buffer to train regression models for counterfactual regret minimization on a game
build_ReservoirRcfrSolver: build an RCFR solver with a reservoir buffer for storing regret data to enable memory-efficient regret minimization on a game
build_RootStateWrapper: build a root state wrapper that analyzes a game subgame, enumerates sequence features, maps information states to sequence indices, and caches terminal values
run_sequence_weights_to_tabular_profile: run sequence weights to tabular profile conversion that maps player sequence weights to action-probability pairs for each information state
